notes.title: MINING UPDATE!
notes.content:

[b]Updated UI[/b]


We've given the UI a fresh coat of paint to make navigating the game, especially the new mining systems, a smoother and more enjoyable experience.[/p]

notes.title: Hot Fixes
notes.content: Fixed some UI scaling and Item filter and few other bugs

notes.title: UI Graphical Update and QoL Changes!
notes.content:
Updated UI Graphics, Layout, More information.
Added Help Menu - with lots of information!
Added Research Finished Tooltip
Added Items Found Tooltip
Added Leaderboard to auto appear (toggle on/off)
Fixed lots of bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes - Bug fixes, Save Auto Backup
notes.content:
Fixed a lot of bugs.
Added a auto backup save every 4 hours.
Detection for corrupt files will automatically attempt to load the backup file.
Added Daily gems for manual save. Once every 24 hours.
More to come...
